name: legato
description: Legato for MIDI instruments and synth slots: a Glide FX (G) on a MIDI or synth note sends its note-on before the previous note's note-off, so mono synths play the two notes legato

branches.note: app_audio_block: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600aa858); afterwards ends a kept note, if any (guard)
render loop: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600bc2d8); the same guard

itcm_branches.note: seq_process_track: bl seq_note_off_q 0x11a4 (the old note before a new one) -> mt_lg_note_off(seq, t, last, mode): keeps the old note for a legato step
seq_process_track: bl seq_trigger_note 0x149c (the step's note) -> mt_lg_trigger(seq, t, rec): ends the kept note after the new note-on
